files.pqledger.conf:
[ledger]
data_dir = ledger
rules_file = rules.conf
budget_file = budgets.conf

[account card]
date_column = Transaction Date
date_format = MM/DD/YYYY
currency_symbol = $
thousands_separator = ,
invert_sign = true

[account giro]
delimiter = ;
skip_lines = 2
date_column = Buchungstag
date_format = DD.MM.YYYY
description_column = Verwendungszweck
amount_mode = debit_credit
debit_column = Soll
credit_column = Haben
decimal_separator = ,
thousands_separator = .
